key.name: profiles
key.description: One JSON object per entry with the keys dir, enabled and chain. The dir is a Claude Code config directory, the value CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR would be set to, and identifies the profile.

key.name: panel-source
key.description: "highest" shows the profile closest to its limit, "active" the most recently updated one and "all" every enabled profile side by side. Any other value is the config directory of the single profile to pin.

key.name: panel-limit
key.description: The rate limit window rendered in the panel button.

key.name: hide-when-stale
key.summary: Hide the panel button without fresh data
key.description: Hide the indicator when no profile has reported within stale-after-minutes instead of dimming it.

key.name: warning-threshold
key.description: Percentage at which usage is rendered as a warning.

key.name: critical-threshold
key.description: Percentage at which usage is rendered as critical.

key.name: notify-threshold
key.description: Send a notification when a profile crosses a threshold upwards.

key.name: stale-after-minutes
key.summary: Age at which data counts as stale
key.description: Payloads only arrive while a Claude Code session renders its status line, so data older than this is marked stale.

key.name: live-fetch
key.summary: Fetch usage from the API between sessions
key.description: Call the endpoint Claude Code's /usage uses, with the token Claude Code stored, whenever the status line data is older than fetch-seconds. The token is never refreshed by the extension.

key.name: fetch-seconds
key.description: Seconds between API calls per profile while live fetch is on.

key.name: profiles-seeded
key.description: Set after the first enable seeds the profile list from the config directories found in the home directory, so a list the user emptied on purpose is not filled again.

key.name: refresh-seconds
key.description: How often the rendered countdowns are recomputed. Usage values themselves arrive through a file monitor, not by polling.
